# Ops handover

Night job: at 01:00 the export job copies the day's approved invoices to /shared/ap/exports and emails Jordan Lee a count. It is defined in /etc/cron.d/ap-export. If it fails, rerun /opt/ap/export.sh by hand in the morning.

# AP export, owned by AP systems
0 1 * * * apops /opt/ap/export.sh
